name: infinity-grove-client
description: Infinity Grove game client: Phaser 4 + TypeScript renderer and Electron desktop shell.

scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build:shell && electron-builder --dir --win --linux --x64
scripts.lint: eslint . && depcruise src tools --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs && vitest run --config vitest.lint.config.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run validate:content && npm run gen:check && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run build && npm run scan:secrets dist
scripts.build:shell: tsc --noEmit -p desktop/tsconfig.json && esbuild desktop/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --external:electron --external:steamworks.js --outfile=dist-desktop/main/main.js && esbuild desktop/preload/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --external:electron --outfile=dist-desktop/preload/preload.js && tsx tools/mark-commonjs.ts
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run build:shell && electron .
scripts.test:shell: npm run build && npm run build:shell && playwright test --config playwright.shell.config.ts

$comment: Renderer libraries are devDependencies: Vite bundles them into dist/. Only the shell runtime (steamworks.js) ships as node_modules.
